_comment: Discount codes for bookings. 'code' is matched case-insensitively (spacing/case don't matter). 'percent' is the percentage off the total booking cost (e.g. 10 = 10% off). 'expires' is optional (format YYYY-MM-DD) — the code stops working after that date. Delete an entry to deactivate it immediately. Example: {"code": "WELCOME10", "percent": 10, "expires": "2026-12-31"}
